_doc: Narration for both cuts. 'cap' is the on-screen caption (Roman Hinglish, numbers as digits); 'tts' is what the voice reads (Hindi in Devanagari, English words in English, numbers spelled out). 'scene' is the scene the line opens; 'min' is the shortest the scene may be (s) whatever the line length. Every number here must exist in verifiedClaims.ts (tests/factualChecks.ts).

master.cap: Kya ho, jab AI sirf answers dena chhod ke... poore systems build karna shuru kar de?
master.tts: क्या हो, जब AI सिर्फ answers देना छोड़ के... पूरे systems build करना शुरू कर दे?

master.cap: Meet Kimi K3.1 Pro. Moonshot AI ka naya open-weight model.
master.tts: Meet Kimi K three point one Pro. Moonshot AI का नया open-weight model.

master.cap: 3-trillion-parameter class, aur 1-million-token context window. Matlab bade projects, zyada context ke saath.
master.tts: Three trillion parameter class, और one million token context window. मतलब बड़े projects, ज़्यादा context के साथ.

master.cap: Coding mein, quick fixes se full-project builds tak. Front-end, interactive Three.js scenes, aur Unity, Unreal, Godot jaise game engines ke saath poore experiences.
master.tts: Coding में, quick fixes से full-project builds तक. Front-end, interactive Three J S scenes, और Unity, Unreal, Godot जैसे game engines के साथ पूरे experiences.

master.cap: 3D mein bhi. Text brief, sketch ya reference image se parametric, CAD-style models. BenchCAD par, tools ke saath, 92.7 percent. Top models ke kareeb.
master.tts: 3D में भी. Text brief, sketch या reference image से parametric, CAD-style models. BenchCAD पर, tools के साथ, ninety-two point seven percent. Top models के करीब.

master.cap: Ek internal test mein, isne human walking simulator banaya. 167 missions, 420 reviews, 36 shoulder-muscle errors fix... aur simulated human, girne se lekar 11.2 seconds ki continuous walking tak.
master.tts: एक internal test में, इसने human walking simulator बनाया. One hundred sixty-seven missions, four hundred twenty reviews, thirty-six shoulder-muscle errors fix... और simulated human, गिरने से लेकर eleven point two seconds की continuous walking तक.

master.cap: Finance mein, documents cross-verify karna, financial models banana, source-backed research. OfficeQA Pro v2 par 64.4. Ye sirf ek summary chatbot nahi hai.
master.tts: Finance में, documents cross-verify करना, financial models बनाना, source-backed research. OfficeQA Pro v2 पर sixty-four point four. ये सिर्फ एक summary chatbot नहीं है.

master.cap: Asli power tab dikhti hai, jab AI ek goal ko steps mein tod de. Plan, search, build, test, debug. Aur apna kaam khud improve kare.
master.tts: असली power तब दिखती है, जब AI एक goal को steps में तोड़ दे. Plan, search, build, test, debug. और अपना काम खुद improve करे.

master.cap: Terminal-Bench 4.0 par, Moonshot ke reported results mein, Kimi K3.1 Pro: 65.7 percent. Claude Opus 5.5: 66.4. Bas thoda sa peeche.
master.tts: Terminal-Bench four point zero पर, Moonshot के reported results में, Kimi K three point one Pro, sixty-five point seven percent. Claude Opus five point five, sixty-six point four. बस थोड़ा सा पीछे.

master.cap: Aur Highspeed version. Moonshot ke mutabik, lagbhag 2 se 3 guna faster.
master.tts: और Highspeed version. Moonshot के मुताबिक, लगभग दो से तीन गुना faster.

master.cap: Sabse interesting? Ye open-weight hai. Full weights 4 November tak release karne ka plan hai.
master.tts: सबसे interesting? ये open-weight है. Full weights चार November तक release करने का plan है.

master.cap: Coding, 3D, research, agents. Focus ab sirf answers par nahi, kaam deliver karne par hai. Aap sabse pehle kya build karoge?
